import sys,json,time

import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
ROOT=Path('/app/output');LOG=ROOT/'actions';LOG.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
r=Robot()
QUAT=[0,1,0,0]
SURFACE=.0202
SCALE=.227185/1024

def obs(cams=['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],depth=False,name='obs'):
 o=r.get_obs(cameras=cams,depth=depth);o.save(str(ROOT/name));return o

def send(points,dt=.05,name='motion',cams=['practice_cam'],video='none'):
 a=np.array(points,float)
 if a.shape[1]==3:a=np.c_[a,np.tile(QUAT,(len(a),1))]
 i=len(list(LOG.glob('*.npz')))
 np.savez(LOG/f'{i:04d}.npz',actions=a,dt=dt,name=name)
 res=r.submit('ee_pose',a,dt=dt,cameras=cams,video=video,note=name)
 res.save(str(ROOT/'runs'/f'{i:04d}_{name}'))
 print(i,name,'tip',res.group('tcp_pose',now=True)[:3].round(6).tolist(),'plan',res.meta.get('plan'),'left',res.meta.get('time_left_s'),flush=True)
 if res.stopped:raise RuntimeError('Incomplete action; inspect before continuing')
 return res

def move(p,seconds=1,name='move'):
 return send([p]*int(round(seconds/.05)),name=name)

def line(a,b,n):return np.linspace(a,b,n).tolist()

def goto(p,speed=.06,name='transit'):
 now=r.get_obs(cameras=[]).group('tcp_pose',now=True)[:3]
 n=max(5,int(np.linalg.norm(np.array(p)-now)/speed/.05))
 pts=line(now,p,n)+[p]*8
 for i in range(0,len(pts),180):res=send(pts[i:i+180],name=name)
 return res

def uv(u,v,z):return [-.1+(512-v)*SCALE,(512-u)*SCALE,z]

def dip():
 goto([-.1,.1856,.07],name='above_ink')
 goto([-.1,.1856,.018],speed=.025,name='dip')
 move([-.1,.1856,.018],.5,'load_ink')
 goto([-.1,.1856,.07],speed=.04,name='leave_ink')

if __name__=='__main__' and '--replay' in sys.argv:
 for f in sorted(LOG.glob('*.npz')):
  a=np.load(f);r.submit('ee_pose',a['actions'],dt=float(a['dt']),video='none')
